items.title: This ER Doctor Became a Hospital’s First Clinical AI Engineer
items.summary: When Boston Children’s Hospital posted a job listing for a prompt engineer in 2023, Dinesh Rai decided to apply. He didn’t expect to get the job.At the time, prompt engineering was being touted as one of the hot new jobs created by generative AI. Companies wanted people who knew how to coax the best answers from large language models (LLMs) by carefully wording instructions, supplying examples, and giving the systems personas or other context.Dinesh RaiEmployer: Boston Children’s HospitalOccupat

items.title: Quoting Jack Despain Zhou
items.summary:
Among the many already existing effects of AI has been a great de-individualization. I open a YouTube video, and I hear Claude. I sit in a conference presentation, and I hear Claude. I open my email inbox, and I find pitches and articles from ostensibly serious people with ostensibly serious credentials attached to ostensibly serious institutions who want to publish things attached to their reputations and mine, and I see Claude.
— Jack Despain Zhou, Spitting in the Face of Glaude
